principles: vary one designated BLUE agent while coupling every other sampling stream across replicas
assign terminal-return advantage only to the designated agent
train ACT spans so improvement must come from using available observations and messages
keep critical and matched-decoy cases balanced within every update
run the unchanged frozen development pulse every ten updates

stages.name: focused_tactical_stabilization
stages.purpose: establish whether focused terminal credit improves ordinary legal tactics

stages.name: focused_handoff_introduction
stages.purpose: increase receiver-action learning without removing ordinary play

stages.name: focused_communication_heavy
stages.purpose: apply sustained pressure to exploit teammate information under terminal reward

stages.name: focused_consolidation
stages.purpose: test retention across tactical and communication-critical play

checkpoint_selection: select once from development metrics after update 80
frozen_policy: the existing rl_v4 frozen OOD evaluation remains unopened and byte-identical
